status: small pilot completed; symmetric n5 cores not competitive; paired-core objective is next
motivation: The19moment supported-unary transform makes a symmetric core worth a concrete native-cost screen. Avoid the impossible Rx/ZZ-only core and do not infer a shallow ansatz from full Lie algebra.

native_block.expression: Rx(a,alpha) Rx(b,beta) CZ(a,b) Ry(a,gamma) Ry(b,delta) CZ(a,b) Rx(a,epsilon) Rx(b,zeta)
native_block.identity: CZ (X tensor X) CZ = Y tensor Y. The middle Ry tensor Ry commutes with Y tensor Y, and outer Rx gates commute with X tensor X; hence the entire block commutes with X tensor X.
native_block.limitation: This remains inside the old obstructed algebra unless a suitable XX block is added. XX breaks the antiunitary witness while preserving global-X symmetry. Parameter independence and shallow reachability are not implied.

phase_gauge.idea: Allow per-column phases while fitting, then correct them on the original unary inputs in one local-Z layer.
phase_gauge.derivation: On u_r=0^(n-r)1^r, tensor Rz(theta_i) has phase f_r=f_0+sum(last r theta_i). For target relative phase phi_r, choose theta_(n-r)=-(phi_r-phi_(r-1)) for r=1..n. This cancels every relative count phase up to one global phase.
phase_gauge.scope: Fit phases need to be evaluated after the entire folded-input/core composition, and final all-column common-phase certification remains mandatory. This does not excuse amplitude or phase approximation errors.

next_actions: Do not repeat failed small symmetric skeletons or scale them blindly to n7.
Use the verified paired_core_objective.py to prepare an exact folded-input warm start with general real cores; no global-X constraint required.
Require total native root-plus-cores depth and independent full-state validation before portfolio integration.
